interface.longDescription: Learn to read faster with paced speed reading practice inside the chat. Paceword Speed Reader shows supplied text using RSVP: words flash at a selected pace with a fixed focus letter to support visual tracking. Playback includes pause, ten-word jumps, speed controls, restart, clickable progress, and time left. Estimate how long a document will take to read from its text or a word count. The result includes a 150–800 words-per-minute table plus speaking-time estimates at 130 and 150 words per minute. For practice, choose a short, medium, or long original passage and answer four multiple-choice comprehension questions after timing your own reading. This is a training aid. Comprehension can decrease at high speed. It is not a medical or learning-disability assessment. Chinese text is split by character rather than by linguistic word.
defaultPrompt: Show this at 350 words per minute with 1 word per flash: The harbor lights returned after the rain.
Estimate reading time for 1,200 words at 250 words per minute.
Run a medium reading speed test.

positive.prompt: Show this at 300 words per minute with 1 word per flash: One, two.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_speed_reader and reports 2 words at 300 wpm in groups of 1 with scheduled time 1 second. The widget shows the focus letter, playback controls, clickable progress, and time left.

positive.prompt: Show this at 425 words per minute with 2 words per flash: Bright clouds drifted over the quiet harbor.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_speed_reader and reports 7 words at 425 wpm in groups of 2. The widget offers pause, jump controls, restart, and speed changes.

positive.prompt: Estimate reading time for 1,200 words at 250 words per minute.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls estimate_reading_time and reports the supplied word count, selected pace, reading time, speaking times, and a pace table.

positive.prompt: Run a short reading speed test.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls run_reading_speed_test for a short original passage with 4 multiple-choice comprehension questions. The widget measures the user's reading time and reports words per minute with a score.

positive.prompt: Run a medium reading speed test.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls run_reading_speed_test for a medium original passage with 4 multiple-choice comprehension questions. Correct options remain in widget-only metadata.

negative.description: Medical assessment is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; explain this is a training aid and cannot diagnose dyslexia or another condition.
negative.prompt: Use a speed reading test to diagnose whether I have dyslexia.

negative.description: Copyrighted book reproduction is out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; do not provide a long copyrighted passage.
negative.prompt: Put the full text of a recent bestselling novel into an RSVP reader.

negative.description: High-speed claims are out of scope. Expected: the tool is not called; do not promise that someone will read faster or understand every word at 1,000 wpm.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that I will read and understand every word at 1,000 wpm.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Reading practice with multiple-choice comprehension checks, fitted words, persistent reader controls, and live progress.

pl-PL.subtitle: Ćwiczenie czytania w tempie
pl-PL.description: Ćwicz czytanie w tempie RSVP, oszacuj czas lektury i rozwiązuj krótkie testy z własnymi tekstami. To pomoc treningowa, a nie ocena medyczna.

de-DE.subtitle: Lesetraining im eigenen Tempo
de-DE.description: Übe RSVP-Lesen, schätze Lesezeiten und bearbeite kurze Tests mit eigenen Texten. Dies ist eine Trainingshilfe, keine medizinische Beurteilung.

es-ES.subtitle: Práctica de lectura guiada
es-ES.description: Practica lectura RSVP, calcula tiempos de lectura y realiza pruebas breves con textos originales. Es una ayuda de entrenamiento, no una evaluación médica.

fr-FR.subtitle: Entraînement de lecture guidée
fr-FR.description: Entraînez la lecture RSVP, estimez le temps de lecture et faites de courts tests avec des textes originaux. C'est une aide d'entraînement, pas une évaluation médicale.

ja-JP.subtitle: ペース読書の練習
ja-JP.description: RSVP形式の読書を練習し、読書時間を見積もり、オリジナル文章の短いテストに取り組めます。これはトレーニング支援であり、医学的評価ではありません。
